title: Gusev demo: Columbia Hills corridor survey and replanning
summary: The drone surveys an uncertain corridor, finds a scarp, the first route is invalidated and the astronaut is replanned around it, reaches goal B and returns to base.
disclaimer: Terrain: NASA/USGS Columbia Hills HiRISE/CTX/HRSC DEM mosaic crop over Spirit's traverse from the landing site to the Columbia Hills (real, preliminary, 8 m display grid averaged from its 1 m mosaic). Rover stop markers: real Spirit stops (NASA). Mission, budgets and the corridor scarp are simulated or synthetic; POIs C and D are real Spirit science sites (NASA), visited here in a simulated story. Rover (1 m/s) and drone (4 m/s, 40 m up) motion is simulated; the rover is faster than real hardware (Perseverance about 4.2 cm/s), the drone below the Ingenuity top speed (about 5 m/s, flown at 10-24 m). Not EVA-certified limits, not a planner output.

ai_disclosure.scope: Fixture generator script and replay fixture structure; the simulated mission, routes and events are generated data, not observations.
ai_disclosure.observational_data: Only the terrain heights come from NASA/USGS data; everything else here is simulated.

sources: Columbia Hills HiRISE/CTX/HRSC DEM mosaic (preliminary, Mars 2020 candidate landing site), NASA JPL Mars Trek (USGS Astrogeology / HiRISE and CTX teams). File CLH_DEM_Mosaic_HiRISE_CTX_HRSC_GCS_MARS_07-10-2018.tif, 2365020753 bytes, SHA-256 8a42cb6f6fe912f46b955317f7e410f68c8bfa70bc1d758f88f0874c33cf8660.
Product page https://trek.nasa.gov/mars/. Native resolution 1.02 m. Not verified here: NASA planetary data served by JPL Mars Trek, see the Trek product page for usage terms.

Crop: 950 x 425 cells of 8 m centred at -14.5819 N, 175.502 E, box average of 7 x 7 source pixels, then bilinear resampling onto a local tangent ENU grid (east = R cos(lat) dlon, north = R dlat); 8 m cells. PROVISIONAL, made by the frontend until the data owner delivers the processed package.
SYNTHETIC: a scarp was added to the hidden evaluator reference to create an adverse case. It does not exist in the NASA terrain data.
ILLUSTRATIVE: uncertainty (sigma), budgets, speeds and consumption rates are assumptions of a simulated mission.
